cited.quote: Scheme for Distribution of 12,000 Milch Cows at Free of cost in rural Village Panchayats for the year 2019-2020
these Schemes are being continued during the current year also.

rationale: C1 (and C5) is the GO dated 26.08.2019 sanctioning free distribution of 12,000 milch cows for 2019-20, an official continuation of the scheme; C2-C4 policy notes report the scheme continuing. The earliest GO in the extracts is C1.

cited.quote: The slum free cities programme at a cost of Rs.15,000 crore has been envisaged
Tamil Nadu Affordable Urban Housing and Habitat Policy - Formulated - Approved - Orders - Issued

rationale: C1-C3 policy notes describe ongoing tenement construction under Housing for All and an envisaged slum-free cities programme; C4/C5 is a general affordable housing policy GO. No GO or sanction specifically for multi-storey apartments for hut dwellers to make cities slum-free.

cited.quote: The Government have sanctioned Rs.104.05 lakh as matching grant to Muslim Women Aid Societies for the year 2017-2018.
The Government sanctions grants twice the amount of donation collected by the societies, at the ratio of 1:2

rationale: C1 and C2 state the 1:2 matching grant continues and report actual sanctions of matching grants for 2017-2018 (C2) and 2018-2019 (C1). Earliest post-office sanction shown is for 2017-18 in C2; exact GO date not given.

cited.quote: order provision of free electricity of 100 units bimonthly to all domestic consumers in all slabs
Commitment letter for providing tariff subsidy

rationale: C3 is G.O.(Ms) No.36 dated 23.05.2016 ordering 100 units bimonthly free to all domestic consumers in all slabs, in force from 23.05.2016; C4 is the accompanying commitment letter for tariff subsidy. Matches the promise.

cited.quote: The Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme is continued from 11.01.2017.
shall be implemented in Tamil Nadu by integrating with Chief Ministers comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme

rationale: C5 reports the scheme renewed and continued from 11.01.2017 with premium paid and beneficiaries treated; C1-C4 are later GOs operating the scheme (2018-2020). Continuation is clearly implemented.

cited.quote: Under this scheme, upto March, 2017, 8.83 lakh mothers have been given these kits for their babies.
Free Sanitary Napkins are distributed annually to 32.79 lakh rural

rationale: C1-C3 show the baby care kit and sanitary napkin schemes continuing with distribution after May 2016 (C2: kits given up to March 2017). No extract mentions an 'Amma maternity sanjeevi'; C4 concerns a maternal nutrition kit under a different scheme name, so that component is not shown.

cited.quote: continuous augmentation of the network to provide quality and uninterrupted power supply to all category of Consumers

rationale: C1-C3 policy notes describe network strengthening aimed at uninterrupted supply; C4 is about free domestic units and C5 an IT policy. No dedicated official step (GO, scheme) for uninterrupted power supply is shown.

cited.quote: Implementation of Replanting and Rejuvenation of Coconut Gardens in Tamil Nadu at a cost of Rs.20.00 crore during 2016-17
Sanction of Livelihood Package for the Coconut farmers affected by Gaja Cyclone at a cost of Rs.81.015 Crores

rationale: C5 is a GO (30.12.2016) for cutting and removal of old, senile, diseased palms and replanting, but at Rs.20 crore on pilot basis versus the promised Rs.800 crore. C2/C4 Gaja package targets cyclone damage, not the promised scheme. Materially reduced scope.
The promise ('these schemes') has no identifiable object. C1/C5 (house repair), C2/C4 (fisheries welfare) and C3 (MLACDS) cannot be tied to a specific commitment.
No extract mentions cellphones for ration cardholders; C1-C5 concern PDS commodities, fair price shops and COVID cash support.

cited.quote: 0.42 lakh laptop computers have been distributed to students till date and the distribution is in progress
to distribute laptop computers to plus one students instead of plus two students from the academic year 2018-19 onwards

rationale: C3 reports free laptop distribution continuing for 2017-18; C4/C5 show distribution to 11th and 12th std in 2018-19 and 11th std from 2019-20. The scheme was continued for higher secondary students. No GO date given; year from C3.

cited.quote: will be provided with a Pongal Gift comprising 1 kg of Raw Rice, 1 kg of Sugar

rationale: C3-C5 are Pongal gift hamper GOs (rice, sugar, sugarcane, cash), and C1/C2 describe Co-optex sales schemes. None provides a Rs.500 Co-optex handloom coupon to family cardholders.

cited.quote: Rs.4,227.98 crore was disbursed benefitting 7,62,772 farmers.
The Government has fixed the target for crop loans of Rs.6,000 crores in the year 2016-17.

rationale: C2 reports cooperative crop loans of Rs.4,227.98 crore disbursed during 2016-17, against a Rs.6,000 crore target (C1). Only one year is shown, below the pace needed for Rs.40,000 crore over five years; cumulative achievement is not shown.

cited.quote: During the academic year 2017-18, 90,607 children have been admitted under this provision.
The Government has so far reimbursed a sum of Rs.644.69 crore to the schools

rationale: C1-C3 show RTE 25% admissions of disadvantaged children in private schools with fee reimbursement continuing after 2016 (admissions in 2017-18, 2018-19, 2019-20; reimbursement to schools). Continuation implemented; year from C2.

cited.quote: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme is providing financial assistance of Rs.18,000 from 1st April, 2018.
Guidelines for payment of benefits consequent on the enhancement of assistance under the Scheme from Rs. 12000/- to Rs.18000/-

rationale: C4 is a GO on guidelines for the enhancement from Rs.12000 to Rs.18000; C1 states Rs.18,000 is provided from 1st April 2018, and C2/C3 confirm. Amount matches the promise.
No extract concerns the Amma Scheme of government reaching out to people or Amma Service Centres; C1-C5 cover other Amma-branded schemes (skill training, driver training, two-wheelers, canteens).

cited.quote: Minimum Support Price (MSP) per quintal of paddy fixed by the Government of India and the incentive

rationale: C1-C3 policy notes report a state incentive over MSP and that sums 'have been provided as incentive'; no GO or official order raising the paddy procurement price is in the extracts. C4/C5 concern copra and green gram.

cited.quote: scheme for effecting 10,000 nos free agriculture service connections within six months against a onetime payment
so that the free supply of power to the farmers continued to be extended to them

rationale: C3 reports a scheme introduced with effect from 24.06.2017 for free agricultural service connections, plus 30,835 connections in 2017-18; C1 and C5 show free power to farmers continuing. Continuation of free farm electricity is implemented.

cited.quote: This scheme will be continue to be implemented for the academic year 2016-17

rationale: C1/C4 are policy notes stating schemes will continue; C2, C3, C5 are COVID school-closure GOs. No administrative order continuing student schemes is shown.

cited.quote: In the Revised Budget Estimates 2016-2017, a sum of Rs.2,705 crores has been allocated for these purposes.

rationale: C3 (budget speech) and C1 (policy note) report allocations for student welfare schemes; under the rules, budget allocations alone ('has been allocated') do not count as an official step. C4/C5 are unrelated. Not started.
